name: Vibe Coding Starter Pack 🔥
description_md:
## What You Get

- 
Four pro PDF cheat sheets for Lovable 2.0, Bolt + Stripe, Replit Agent v2, and Cursor AI—perfect side-kicks while you watch the free YouTube masterclass.

- 
Plug-and-play n8n workflows to auto-generate images from prompts and to edit uploaded images on the fly—drop them straight into your Lovable builds.

- 
Brief Loom tutorial that walks you through setting up GitHub on your laptop, so version control is ready in minutes.

- 
Plain-English security quick-guide showing what each platform locks down, what could still break, and the fastest fixes before launch.

Note: Miro shown in video not included
💖 This video and associated resources took 3 weeks to create—if it levels up your builds, feel free to support the channel OR join my community Early AI-dopters for even deeper content
